用精确分数展开并比较多项式。支持加减乘、常数除法及有限整数幂；函数、变量分母和一: Expands and compares polynomials using exact fractions. Supports addition, subtraction, multiplication, constant division and bounded integer powers. Functions, variable denominators and general theorems are unsupported. Multi-letter names are single variables; use * for multiplication.
